defect.class: upstream GStreamer state-transition lock-order deadlock under rapid pipeline churn
defect.sibling: typefindelement streaming thread in futex_wait holding the pad lock
defect.installed_version: GStreamer 1.28.7-2.1 (cachyos-extra-v3; newest available in the repositories)
defect.upstream_reference: Eyevinn/strom#963 (same two-thread signature on GStreamer 1.28.6); upstream report ready in evidence/dac-v35-pcm-closure/2026-09-30-smsl-152a85dd/diagnostics/wedge-2026-10-03/upstream-report.md
defect.get_state_timeout_note: a bounded get_state() in a sibling thread does not bound a preceding/concurrent set_state() and itself blocks in g_cond_wait_until when the state lock is held

pre_fix_reproduction.result: WEDGED: single in-process characterizer hammer froze inside characterize_local_file set_state(PAUSED) after ~50 s; typefindelement in futex_wait; the harness stall watchdog captured all-thread Python stacks and exited; supervisor classification CHILD_NONZERO_EXIT (exit 1), seal_problems []
pre_fix_reproduction.single_thread_meaning: the app-side calls are strictly sequential in one thread, so app-level serialization alone cannot prevent the deadlock

A_serialized_owner_with_settled_protocol.reason: the fresh single-thread reproduction wedges inside one set_state() before any settling point; historical single-thread churn also wedged in ~47 s, and the app-style sequential load/stop loop still wedged after ~148k/189k cycles

B_remove_hazardous_calls_from_owner_thre.reason: bounding UI exposure does not bound the wedge: a stuck pipeline keeps its GStreamer threads and locks forever; the acceptance requires no permanent wedge. Additionally the prepare request build (bounded characterization worker) still executes inline on the Qt owner thread (recorded GST_LIFECYCLE_GATE_BLOCKER in ADR-0010 section 9)

C_process_isolation_of_hazardous_branch.reason: the characterization pipeline is already subprocess-isolated and the Direct playback path still wedged (soak attempt 5); isolating the playback pipeline would require a whole-engine process boundary, which the campaign explicitly avoids unless necessary

D_upstream_fixed_version.reason: no fixed build exists in the configured repositories; the fix cannot be proven on this exact version

acceptance_criteria_status.known_reproducer_no_longer_wedges: UNPROVEN (reproducer still wedges at the evaluated HEAD)
acceptance_criteria_status.characterization_ownership_bounded_cance: PARTIAL (worker is bounded/cancellable; wait path still inline on the owner thread)
acceptance_criteria_status.generation_tests_green: GREEN (existing suites) but insufficient to clear the gate
acceptance_criteria_status.shutdown_recovery_green: NOT_EVALUATED (the wedge itself prevents a clean shutdown path)

next_actions: keep the upstream report ready to file and watch for a fixed GStreamer release
